author: Stahly
description:
A new edition of Warhammer 40,000 means a new wave of starter sets, and 11th Edition brings the biggest lineup yet. We're reviewing and unboxing all three tiers: the Introductory Set with its exclusive miniatures, the new Getting Started sets that split the two factions for the first time, and the large Starter Set with two full Space Marine and Ork Combat Patrols and a complete Manufactorum Ruins terrain spread. We have an unboxing video that covers all the box contents, and throughout this review you'll find high-res sprue images for every miniature across all three sets.

The post Every 11th Edition Warhammer 40k starter set unboxed & reviewed appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Every 11th Edition Warhammer 40k starter set unboxed & reviewed
